# axiz-parent-tooling

Parent for build tools, archetype resources and code generators. These artifacts may use parsing,
rendering and formatting libraries. They are outside the production core layer.

It retains JSpecify, JUnit, quality checks and module naming from the library conventions.
`axiz-parent-core` retains its closed production dependency allowlist. Application libraries must
select the parent appropriate to their architectural layer; tooling is not a way to bypass core rules.
